name: Ukrainian TTS Declension Stress Paradigms
description: Full declension paradigms with stress for Ukrainian pronouns, determiners and numerals (closed classes, often with moving stress: оди́н – одного́, ві́сім – восьми́, той – того́). Every polysyllabic form is listed; one-syllable forms (мій, нас, цим) need no stress mark and are omitted.
verification: Every form was written by hand and then cross-checked against two independent open sources: the ukrainian-word-stress dictionary (lang-uk, MIT; data derived from ULIF 'Словники України') and the declension tables of the English Wiktionary (via the wiktextract extraction published at kaikki.org; CC BY-SA). A form is included only if at least one source confirms it and no source contradicts it; 'verified_by' lists the sources that confirm it. No data was copied from either source.

notation.uppercase: Stressed vowel written as the only uppercase letter.
notation.slot: case (nom gen dat acc ins loc), prefixed with m_/f_/n_/pl_ for gendered forms; the suffix _pr marks the form used after a preposition (від нього́ vs. його́); nom_m / nom_f mark gendered numerals. Accusative and locative forms that coincide with another case are listed under that case only for adjectival words (m_acc = nom or gen, f_loc = f_dat, pl_acc = pl_nom or pl_gen, pl_loc = pl_gen).
notation.homograph: true when the same spelling has a different stress in another word (тому́ / то́му from том, сам: само́го / са́мий: са́мого) or in another slot; disambiguate before applying. Variants of the same word (на ко́го, до цьо́го after a preposition; dialectal forms) are not homographs: the listed form is always acceptable and the variant is named in note. Proper names are not counted.
notation.verified_by: Which independent sources confirm the stress of this form: 'ulif', 'wiktionary', or 'manual' (orthoepic dictionary entry checked by hand; see note).
